title: 〜気味
simpleExplanation: 〜気味 means "a touch of, slightly, showing signs of". It describes a mild, current state that the speaker senses, usually an unwelcome one: a bit tired, a bit behind schedule, coming down with a cold.
whenUsed: Both registers. It attaches to a Vます stem (太り気味, 遅れ気味) or a noun (風邪気味, 緊張気味). Before a noun it becomes 気味の / 気味な; as an adverb 気味に. It is about how things are now, not about a repeated habit (that is 〜がち).
formation: Vます + 気味 / N + 気味

items.label: 疲れ気味だ
items.description: Showing signs of tiredness lately (mild, ongoing).

items.label: 疲れがちだ
items.description: Tends to get tired often (habit, not now).

examples.reading: さいきんすこしふとりぎみだ。
examples.en: I've been putting on a little weight lately.
examples.note: Vます + 気味 with 少し.

examples.ja: 風邪気味なので、早く帰ります。
examples.reading: かぜぎみなので、はやくかえります。
examples.en: I feel like I'm coming down with a cold, so I'll go home early.
examples.note: N + 気味: 風邪気味 = a touch of a cold.

examples.ja: 仕事が遅れ気味で、焦っている。
examples.reading: しごとがおくれぎみで、あせっている。
examples.en: Work is running a bit behind and I'm getting anxious.
examples.note: 遅れ気味で as a connective.

examples.ja: 彼は面接の前で、少し緊張気味だった。
examples.reading: かれはめんせつのまえで、すこしきんちょうぎみだった。
examples.en: He was a little nervous before the interview.
examples.note: Observed slight state in someone else.

examples.ja: 最近、寝不足気味なので、今日は早く寝よう。
examples.reading: さいきん、ねぶそくぎみなので、きょうははやくねよう。
examples.en: I've been a bit short of sleep lately, so I'll go to bed early today.
examples.note: 気味 + な before ので.

similarGrammar.difference: Repeated tendency over time; 気味 is a present, mild state.
A quality or impression (子供っぽい); not a temporary state.
Appearance based on what you see; 気味 is a felt slight degree.

commonMistakes.wrong: 子供の頃は病気気味だった。
commonMistakes.right: 子供の頃は病気がちだった。
commonMistakes.why: A long-term tendency is がち; 気味 is for a slight current state.
Attach to the Vます stem.

commonMistakes.right: 少し元気になってきた。
commonMistakes.why: 気味 is used for undesirable or at least non-positive states.

usageNotes: Common nouns: 風邪気味, 疲れ気味, 緊張気味, 不足気味, 焦り気味.
Common verb stems: 太り気味, 遅れ気味, 上がり気味, 下がり気味, 押され気味.
気味 is read ぎみ in this pattern (as a standalone noun 気味 is きみ, e.g. 気味が悪い).
jlptTips: A present mild state with 最近・ちょっと・少し and a Vます stem or noun → 気味.
The main distractor is がち; decide by time frame (now vs. habitually).
Watch for the modifier form 気味の/気味な before a noun; options with bare 気味 + noun are traps.
